title: Verify: Game world loader and runtime wiring unit tests
summary: Add Vitest proving loadWorldFromYaml and createRuntime with fixture YAML text.
description:
Context: ACT-GAME added loader/runtime without tests.
Desired behavior: Unit tests parse fixture YAML string mirroring world-content.yaml contract and wire createRuntime; invalid YAML missing id throws.
Expected result: Filtered vitest for game content/runtime tests passes with no filesystem reads of the real repo.
Why: Covers REQ-GAME loader and runtime/content separation wiring.
acceptance_criteria: Given fixture YAML matching world-content.yaml fields, when loadWorldFromYaml runs, then id is the-boys-room, title is The Boy's Room, startingScene is bedroom.
Given createRuntime('the-boys-room','bedroom'), when called, then RuntimeState matches those ids.
Given YAML missing id, when loadWorldFromYaml runs, then it throws an Error naming id.

out_of_scope: Reading live disk outside test fixture strings

technical_constraints: Unit tests only; YAML fixture must mirror world-content.yaml field contract

steps.action: Add script test:game=vitest run loadWorld.test.ts runtime.test.ts. Keep existing vitest dependency from VRF-FE.
steps.expected: test:game script is available for filtered game unit tests.

steps.action: Add fixture constant WORLD_YAML matching contract of world-content.yaml (id/title/startingScene). Test parse success; test missing id throws matching /id/.
steps.expected: loadWorldFromYaml unit tests pass against the world-content.yaml contract fixture.
